The '''dire sword''' was an archaic weapon used by duelists and other students of classical fighting styles. Crafted with tradition rather than technology, the weapon was basically a large two-handed [[Sword/Legends|longsword]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />
